facts.summary: Priced heavily dilutive $12M unit offering with warrants at $0.25 · Phase 3 start · LB1148 in post-surgical bowel recovery · not yet approved
facts.indication: return of bowel function after GI/abdominal surgery

evidence.summary: We are offering Class A Units, with each Class A Unit consisting of one share of our common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the “common stock”) together with warrants
evidence.safety: LB1148 was well tolerated with 10.9% and 4.8% of patients in the LB1148 group and placebo group, respectively, experiencing a drug-related adverse event.
